This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/objectql`, touching **5** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/objectql/src/index.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/objectql/src/index.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **58** of **210** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **19** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 9d5ebfdef05caf03b5b0f2013873f1f704c8145b` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `19a68416bc60b8963d895d1aaad9ee98eab872d7` — the merge of head `e9672b771a25cc357584c0ae6e4373e7646e22ee` into base `9d5ebfdef05caf03b5b0f2013873f1f704c8145b`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 19a68416bc60b8963d895d1aaad9ee98eab872d7 && git checkout 19a68416bc60b8963d895d1aaad9ee98eab872d7
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 9d5ebfdef05caf03b5b0f2013873f1f704c8145b e9672b771a25cc357584c0ae6e4373e7646e22ee && git checkout -B drift-repro 9d5ebfdef05caf03b5b0f2013873f1f704c8145b && git merge --no-ff e9672b771a25cc357584c0ae6e4373e7646e22ee

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 9d5ebfdef05caf03b5b0f2013873f1f704c8145b
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 9d5ebfdef05caf03b5b0f2013873f1f704c8145b` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

REWORK round 1 · PR #27648 @ `9773776b` · 2026-10-29T16:20Z

The seat review and an independent full Fable review agree. Both fixes are small; the status mapping, guide edits, changeset and tests otherwise hold.

## Must fix

1. **A driver's ledgered `code` is discarded.** Triage 6491225200 ruled "a typed refusal keeps its code and message (ADR-0112)". The floor passes only status + message (`external-driver-floor.ts` ~:180-184), and `ExternalReadRefusedError` hard-codes `INVALID_QUERY` (`external-driver-errors.ts` ~:77). A driver throwing `{status: 400, code: 'INVALID_FILTER'}` (driver-sql's own refusal shape, `sql-driver.ts` ~:862-866) answers `INVALID_QUERY`, with its code only on `cause`. The engine's non-floored path keeps the code (`engine.ts` ~:6983-6992; the door's `ErrorCode.safeParse` in `types/src/thrown-http-error.ts` ~:222-228).
   - **Fix:** read a string `error.code` in the floor; the constructor takes `remoteCode?`; `code = ErrorCode.safeParse(remoteCode).success ? remoteCode : INVALID_QUERY` (the same membership test the door uses); add `details.remoteCode`. One test for a code-carrying throw, one for an unledgered code falling back.
2. **A refusal can relay a policy-subtree field or comparand to the caller.** The floor sends `query.where` by reference, so the `'policy'` provenance mark from sharing/RLS scope reaches the driver intact. A refusal such as "the remote cannot run a filter on 'region' with comparand EMEA", where `region` came from a policy subtree, now answers 400 with that text. Before this PR it was withheld (503). The "cut at the engine boundary" is not redaction: `redactPropagatedDriverFault` acts only on SQL-dump-shaped messages, and the door ships a declared-4xx message verbatim (truncated at 500). This bypasses the fail-closed rule in `filter-subtree-provenance.ts` and reopens #7929 for plugin drivers.
   - **Fix:** in `readCapped`, disclose the driver's message only when the sent `where` is undefined, or `filterSubtreeProvenanceOf(where) === 'author'` and no descendant carries `'policy'`. Otherwise keep `ExternalReadRefusedError` (400, same code rule as fix 1, `details.remoteStatus`) with a fixed message ("the plugin driver of datasource '<ds>' refused this read on '<object>'; its reason is in the server log") and log the driver's text at `warn`, as `remoteFailure` does. Pin with a test using `markFilterSubtreeProvenance`.

## Nits (optional)

- Guide: say that the refusal message is caller-visible (do not put remote URLs/hosts in it), and that a remote 404 on a list endpoint often means a base-path or mapping misconfiguration rather than a bad query.

## Holds

400/404/422 → refused, 409/412 and the outage set → 503 with text withheld: right for reads. Guide edits match the code. Changeset `patch` · `Clause-②: no` (no ledger code, no accept-set change). Tests make real assertions on both bands; 45/45 at head, and exactly the 4 new cases fail against `main`'s floor.

Same branch, same claim. The surface stays `packages/objectql/src/**`, `content/docs/**`, `.changeset/**`.

ACCEPT · PR #27648 @ `e9672b771a25cc357584c0ae6e4373e7646e22ee` · 2026-10-29T17:04Z

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 插件驱动外部数据源上，驱动以 400/404/422 拒绝一次读取时，答 400（不再是 503「稍后重试」）；驱动声明的已登记错误码原样保留，否则为 `INVALID_QUERY`；驱动的原话只在过滤条件全是调用方自己写的时候才回给调用方，带共享/行级权限谓词时改用固定句子，原话进服务器日志。
- **为什么改：** #27471：按名拒绝（如不支持的运算符）被说成「数据源不可用、稍后重试」，调用方无从修正；分诊裁决要求保留驱动的错误码与原话（ADR-0112）。
- **风险与回滚：** 只影响被兜底的插件驱动数据源的 `find` 拒绝路径；认证/限流/5xx 仍是 503 且不回原话。changeset `patch` · `Clause-②: no`。还原即回滚。
- **先看：** `packages/objectql/src/external-driver-floor.ts` 的 `readRefusal` 与 `whereIsCallersOwn`，以及 `external-driver-errors.ts` 的 `ExternalReadRefusedError`。
- **两分钟验证：** 单跑 `external-driver-floor.test.ts`（49 例）。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

席位意见：ACCEPT。round 0 由独立 Fable 复核 REWORK（两项 must-fix），本轮 `e9672b77` 两项均已关闭。

## 席位核对

1. **Shape:** the round-1 delta (`9773776b..e9672b77`, 5 files, +154/−29), read by the seat. The independent Fable reviewer's delta pass was cut off by a model quota (HTTP 429). This PR touches no contract face, so the seat's own read is the review of record.
   - **Code:** `ExternalReadRefusedError` keeps a driver's `code` when `ErrorCode.safeParse` accepts it (the door's own membership test), else `INVALID_QUERY`; `details.remoteCode` names what was declared.
   - **Message:** `whereIsCallersOwn` discloses only when `where` is undefined, or its root is marked `'author'` and no descendant is `'policy'`. Read against `main`: the authz middleware marks the caller's `where` `'author'` only when it is still the caller's verbatim object, and wraps policy scopes as `{ $and: [caller, ...policy] }`, whose unmarked root withholds. The sharing plugin follows the same pattern. So any policy-scoped read withholds, and an unscoped caller filter discloses. Fail-closed in every case the seat traced.
2. **Premise measured:** the dev reports 4 new pins (ledgered code kept; unledgered falls back; unmarked `where` withheld and logged; policy arm under an author root withheld), three ablations each red on its own pin, floor file 49/49, objectql 9167 tests, 91/91 derived gates, 0 NOT-MEASURED (report 6503176904).
3. **Gate check-runs on `e9672b77`:** 50 runs: 37 success, 13 skipped, 0 failed or pending. `mergeable_state: clean`.
4. **Accepted deviations:** none beyond the REWORK.
   - The PR body is from round 0 and is stale: "always `INVALID_QUERY`", the old test counts, and the triage-versus-ruling note, which is superseded. This comment and the report correct it; the changeset and the guide match the code.
5. **Out of scope, noted:** a driver that declares a ledgered code whose usual status differs (a 404-class code, for example) answers it at status 400. The door reads status first, so the pair is coherent on the wire, if unusual. It is not filed.
6. **Landing:** not governed (`check-governed-merges --pr 27648`: 306 lines ≤ 3000). No contract face is touched (`Clause-②: no`, no published schema, not governed), so CI plus this read suffices. Landed by the seat through the relay.
